scope: Website SEO implemented from a shared genre/ASO semantic core. Store listings were researched but not edited.
methodology: Observed vocabulary from official store pages + verified WKos mechanics + owner-authorized query hypotheses. Exact phrasing, demand, reach and priorities remain editorial estimates, not keyword-tool measurements. English is the main discovery market assumption; Ukrainian targets the existing Car Hero localization.

priority_legend.P1: Primary relevant intent: landing-page metadata and introduction.
priority_legend.P2: Supporting intent: natural gameplay explanations and questions.
priority_legend.P3: Research reserve: requires a separate localization or page.

estimated_reach_legend.broader: Hypothesis: wider genre audience; likely more varied intent.
estimated_reach_legend.niche: Hypothesis: narrow mechanic or brand intent; useful even with low volume.

measurement.note: No measured figures available. No promised ranking or traffic increase.

sources.signal: Current listing fetched on 2026-10-22. Auto combat, roguelite car shooter, top-down view, waves, permanent upgrades. Regular-sector bosses use a timer; nodes are introduced in the tutorial. Anonymous US response did not expose a reliable installation/pre-registration button, so release status retains the last owner-confirmed pre-registration state.

changes: Open Graph and Twitter text; image descriptions.
Visible gameplay language and useful questions; no hidden keyword blocks.
VideoGame and BreadcrumbList data for each game page; Ukrainian schema uses the Ukrainian page URL and description.
Existing reciprocal Car Hero hreflang preserved.
Sitemap lastmod updated only for changed pages.
Steam home-page wishlist links replaced with newsletter updates until an actual listing exists.
Car Hero boss description aligned to current Google Play copy.
not_performed: No Google Play Console or Steamworks listing edits.
No fabricated reviews, ratings, prices, release dates or software offers.
No meta-keywords tag or repeated exact-match keyword list.

store_handoff.steam_short_description_draft: A first-person money sorting simulator. Turn a chaotic bank vault into shelves of neat cash bundles: sort banknotes, strap 100 matching notes and upgrade your equipment. Organize at your own pace, explore safe deposit boxes and make it rain.

validation_plan: After publication: verify Pages deployment and compare all five public page bodies with the committed content.
Search Console: compare page impressions, clicks, CTR and average position over 28 days, split by country and device, against a comparable baseline; early data for new pages may be sparse.
Classify queries into brand, sorting/organizing, car survival/shooter, and platform intent. Expand pages only for relevant impressions.
Measure actual newsletter signups and store referrals where existing tooling permits. Do not add tracking silently.
Google Play Console: use acquisition/search-term data and listing experiments for ASO validation; Steamworks: validate tags and store traffic after the page becomes public.
